description_en: Invoke the UpdateGroupIpMappingRule API to modify the IP redirection settings of an authorization rule for an instance group
description_zh: 调用UpdateGroupIpMappingRule接口修改实例组授权规则IP重定向的相关信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc update-group-ip-mapping-rule --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --group-ip-mapping-rule-id im-irrp3bzuu5nrbx0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateGroupIpMappingRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance group.
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the authorization rule for IP redirection in the instance group.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, start with a letter or Chinese character, and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行实例组IP重定向的授权规则描述。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the authorization rule for IP redirection in the instance group.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, start with a letter (uppercase or lowercase) or a Chinese character, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行实例组IP重定向的授权规则名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: ip_mapping_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the authorization rule to be redirected
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行重定向的授权规则的ID
parameters.name: group_ip_mapping_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address that requires redirection.
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行重定向的IP地址
parameters.name: mapping_ip

parameters.help_en: The destination IP address to access
parameters.name: destination_ip

parameters.help_en:
The client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter to guarantee uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run of the request. Valid values:
true: Sends a dry run request without modifying the IP redirection settings of the instance group authorization rule. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business limits are met. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会修改实例组授权规则IP重定向的相关信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例组所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The ID of the cloud connector instance group
